title: Unlocking porosity: structural tuning of urea-based MOFs via reaction parameter control
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,27531-27543
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02649K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Leili Esrafili, Ocean Cheung, Peter Adriaensens, Elien Derveaux, Lawson T. Glasby, Peyman Z. Moghadam, Christophe M. L. Vande Velde
This study reports the synthesis of urea-functionalized MOFs (UA-1, UA-2, UA-3) where synthesis conditions controlled interpenetration levels, and a detailed analysis of host–guest interactions between the UA-3 framework and various solvents.
